ios.desc:
Lifelong – lifetime wellbeing planner.

Lifelong is not your usual food tracker, it is your lifespan management tool. It calculates your potential lifespan based on your relatives' lifespans and your body mass index, and then you are able to log not just food, but your daily routines, life events, vacations, happy moments and sicknesses.

New events, food, drinks and other things that affect your lifespan are added to our database every day. You don't need to update your app for that as it fetches new data automatically.

During onboarding, you will be asked about your personal data, including your date of birth and your relatives' lifespans. This information is essential for the app as we use it to calculate your potential lifespan and potential date of passing away. 
Please note, that all data you log into the app during onboarding and on a daily bases is stored only on your app, it does not require any authentication. It means that if you remove the app, all your data is gone permanently and we are not able to recover it. We at Lifelong care about your privacy, we don't even use any kind of third party analytics to track app usage.
